stage1.impression: A moody, coherent backlit forest-in-haze: one low sun, long shadows raking toward the lens and the dark speaker set against a glowing wall, which is the right idea. But it reads as CG. The whole frame is one sepia wash. The ground is smooth tan sand or carpet, not a forest floor. The mid trunks are bark-less, plaster-smooth repeats. The speaker's face is a near-black slab with only a thin rim on its right edge, so it reads as a box more than as a $20,000 object.

blocking_9: The forest floor reads as pine-needle litter at real scale (needles, cones, twigs, small relief) within 3 m of the speaker, not as sand or carpet.
The light in the smoke reads as shafts between the trunks: in the band 600-950 x, 0-400 y, lum_range is at least 110, against 73 now.
The shadows carry a cool skylight fill, so the frame is no longer a single sepia tone: the shadow ground has b_median at least 60 where r_median is about 124.
The speaker carries a warm rim on both vertical edges and on its top, and the woofer and lining read faintly through the tint: the body's lum_p95 is 110 or more while its median stays at 25 or less.
The mid-distance trunks show bark texture and differ in shape, with no visible repeats.
No cool grey sky strip shows through the smoke anywhere in the frame.

defects.what: The ground reads as fine tan sand or felt with crumbs. There are no pine needles, cones or twigs, the relief is too low, and the five dry branches are not visible.
A cool blue-grey vertical strip shows (b 56, against about 126 in the surrounding smoke). The HDRI sky shows through at the edge of the volume, a seam between it and the modelled smoke.
The mid trunks are smooth, pale, bark-less tapered columns of near-identical shape, which read as plaster or cardboard repeats.
The grade is monochrome sepia with no cool component anywhere. It reads as a filter rather than as a morning sun with a skylit shadow side.

The speaker's front is crushed to near black (median 11, p5 4.7). The woofer and lining barely read, and there is no rim on the left edge (a soft step of -74 over 19 px, against a crisp -196 over 4 px on the right).
The smoke is an even beige wall (range 73) without the trunk-cut shafts the card promises, so the air reads as flat fog.
The nearest left trunks are veiled pale (median 119) by smoke in front of them, so the foreground has no dark framing and depth flattens.
The contact reads only moderately: the footing shows no needles pushed aside and no occlusion darker than the cast shadow.

changes.problem: The ground reads as sand or carpet, not pine litter, and that is the largest tell that this is CG.

evidence.measured: Smooth tan surface (median 87.5, range 104) with fine crumb texture and no needle strands, cones or twigs at a crop of 3x.

change.from: forrest_ground_03 tinted 25 % toward #5A4330, displacement 0.04 m, five dry_branches_medium_01 3 to 12 m behind
change.to: Ground tinted 55 % toward #4A3626 with texture scale halved, so the needles read at real size. Displacement 0.08 m. Scatter about 400 pine cones and needle-clump or twig assets across 0.5 to 12 m, with 12 of the dry branches from 1.5 m behind and some in the foreground at camera left and right.

changes.expected: Needle strands, cones and twigs resolve in the foreground; the ground gets darker and richer, with micro-shadow in the sunlit patches.

changes.problem: The shadows have no skylight, so the frame is a single sepia tone and reads as a filter.

evidence.measured: The shadow ground measures r 124, g 81, b 47 (r/b 2.6), and the whole top band measures b 126 against r 190.

change.setting: Bounce area lamp colour / Sky strength
change.to: Bounce #A9B4C2 at irradiance 1.8, and sky strength 0.12, so the shadow side takes cool open-sky fill while the sunlit smoke stays warm.

changes.expected: The cast shadows and the speaker's front go slightly cool, against the warm sunlit smoke, and the warm-cool contrast reads.

changes.problem: The smoke is an even glowing wall, not shafts cut by the trunks, so the scene's one idea is half-delivered.

evidence.measured: lum_range 73, p5 123, p95 196: almost no light-and-dark banding in the air.

change.from: density 0.14, cut 0.58, soft 0.14, floor 0.004; sun irradiance 24
change.to: Density 0.10, cut 0.50, soft 0.25, floor 0.008, so the air between the trunks is filled more evenly. Sun irradiance 36, and the sun azimuth 164 to 172, so the beams pass between the right-hand trunks toward the camera.

changes.expected: Visible beams fan from upper right through the trunk gaps, with darker occluded bands behind each trunk.

changes.problem: The speaker has no rim on its left edge or top, and its front is crushed, so it reads as a dark box rather than as a lit object.

evidence.measured: Body median 11.3, p5 4.7, p95 94. The left-edge step is -74 over 19 px; the right edge is crisp at -196 over 4 px.

change.from: kicker 1 at azimuth -160, elevation 14, irradiance 14; kicker 2 at azimuth 150, elevation 14, irradiance 10
change.to: Kicker 1 to azimuth -150, elevation 22, irradiance 20, narrowed to 0.3 × 2.4 m to give a crisp left and top rim. Kicker 2 to irradiance 16. Add a front fill of 1.2 × 1.2 m at azimuth -20, elevation 5, irradiance 0.6, #A9B4C2, to lift the woofer and lining through the tint.

changes.expected: Thin warm lines on both vertical edges and on the top edge; the woofer cone just reads through the smoked acrylic.

changes.problem: The mid-distance trunks are smooth, pale, repeated columns that read as plaster.

evidence.measured: Trunk median 143, range 72: barely darker than the smoke (164), with no bark detail and identical flares.

change.to: Randomise the lean (±3°), the taper and the flare per trunk; triple the bark texture scale and bump on trunks beyond 6 m, so the bark survives the haze; vary the radius from 0.12 to 0.35 m; and add 4 to 6 broken snags and saplings in the mid band.

changes.expected: The trunks differ in shape and lean, and bark ridges read faintly through the smoke.

changes.problem: The HDRI sky shows through as a cool grey strip at the edge of the smoke volume, a seam.

evidence.measured: r 65, g 59, b 56, against r 190, b 126 in the smoke around it.

change.to: 70 × 25 × 20 m centred at (0, 14), so every ray behind the trunks passes through smoke.

changes.expected: The strip is gone; the gaps behind the trunks fill with the warm glow.

changes.problem: The nearest left trunks are veiled pale, so the foreground has no dark frame and the depth flattens.

evidence.measured: Near trunk median 119, close to the smoke behind it.

change.to: Fade the smoke density to 0 within 4 m of the camera (a gradient mask), and move two trunks to 1.5 to 2 m from the camera at frame left, partly cut by the frame edge.

changes.expected: Dark near-trunk silhouettes frame the left edge, with a clear dark-to-glow depth from foreground to background.

changes.problem: The contact is plausible but generic: no litter is displaced at the feet.

evidence.measured: Footing band median 41.6 and crush 7.5 %: the cast shadow only, with no denser occlusion line at the feet.

change.to: Sink the feet 10 mm, and scatter needles and two cones against the base, a few overlapping the bottom edge in front.

changes.expected: The speaker reads as standing in the litter, with a thin, dense occlusion line along the base.

out_of_scope.request: None: no change to the speaker is needed for this frame.
out_of_scope.why: Its silhouette and tint suit the concept, and the problems are in the set, the light and the volume.
